_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: A command in the text box doesn't take a view's message along. The agent has shown, in the conversation /c/{{SLUG}}, a page with output_html: "the view" is the frame ".output-iframe-tool iframe". Its button #send asks to send "echo: sent from the page" as the user's message, then shows how that went in #sent. The conversation's directory holds t.sh, which clears the screen, prints "!echo from-terminal" and "menu-ready", then waits reading input. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match. "The consent bar" is data-testid "mcp-app-consent", where the host asks the user's OK for links and downloads a view asks for. "The text box" is data-testid "message-input", and "the draft label" data-testid "view-draft", which shows above the text box while it holds a message a view asked to send. To "send T": fill data-testid "message-input" with T and click data-testid "send-button". "The agent says T": the last ".message-agent" whose text contains T should be visible (timeout 30s). To choose a terminal menu item, click the button with aria-label exactly "Terminal menu", then the button with exactly that text inside ".overflow-menu-panel" (two real clicks). Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. Fill the text box with "!bash t.sh" and click [data-testid="send-button"]. ".terminal-panel-tab-running" should be visible. 2. Retry the following as one block until it passes (timeout 15s): fill the text box with ""; choose the terminal menu item "Insert visible screen into input"; eval, in the page, /menu-ready/.test(document.querySelector('[data-testid="message-input"]').value): it must return true. 3. Fill the text box with "". Click the view's #send. Eval, in the page, document.querySelector('[data-testid="message-input"]').value === "echo: sent from the page": it must return true. The draft label should be visible. 4. Choose the terminal menu item "Insert visible screen into input". Eval, in the page, (() => { const value = document.querySelector('[data-testid="message-input"]').value; return value.trim().startsWith("!echo from-terminal") && !value.includes("sent from the page"); })(): it must return true. There should be no draft label (count 0), and the view's #sent should have exactly the text "The user declined.".

steps.expression: (() => { const value = document.querySelector('[data-testid="message-input"]').value; return value.trim().startsWith('!echo from-terminal') && !value.includes('sent from the page'); })()
